1.name: Episode 5

1.overview: Minjae and Youjin help Sejin pursue Subin. Youjin's test of love triggers Minjae's old insecurities.

1.name: Episode 8
1.overview: Minjae defies Youseong. Sejin discovers their secret and challenges Youjin to a risky bet.

1.name: Episode 9
1.overview: Youjin grows increasingly close to Professor Jihoon. He shares that he met Minjae in the US and gives her Minjae's new contact information. But Youjin brushes it off, insisting that their love is over. Meanwhile, Youseong happens to get in touch with Minjae and secretly investigates the couple's past without Youjin's knowledge. What could have happened between two people who were once so deeply in love?

overview: Minjae, a former swimmer, lost a leg to illness. Now a PhD student, he's built a quiet, controlled life, until Yujin, a master's student starting over after losing her way, throws it off balance. In a robotics lab, their romance turns fiery, bittersweet, and tender.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Minjae was a swimmer in high school, until illness cost him a leg. Now a robotics PhD student, he plays the part of someone unbothered—but one simple, aching wish remains: falling in love. He overthinks everything and fears getting hurt, until one day, the right person walks in. Yujin left fashion major behind, adrift with no clear path, until Minjae opens her eyes to the world of robotics—and a new dream. Everything about it is unfamiliar and hard, but her feelings for him never waver. A spark at first sight shakes up the quiet lab, and Yujin's fearless pursuit cracks open Minjae's guarded heart. Slowly, the two grow closer. Messier and harder to predict than any robot, a romance begins—fiery, bittersweet, and tender.

title: Between Steps
